Emma (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Nimbus Analytics onboarding. Thanks for joining. Quick goal: get prod-readiness for search + embeddings by end of Q2.
Devin (Solutions Eng): 👍 Can you confirm which models we’re starting with? open-bert-16 or akira-v2?
Aisha (Nimbus): We’d like embeddings first for semantic search (customer support KB). Priority: low-latency lookups, batch embed for 5M docs initially.
Priya (CS Ops): Success criteria from our side: 99th pct query latency < 200ms for <64 token queries, embedding throughput 5k/s peak, and role-based access for internal teams.
Marko (Platform Eng): We’ll need sample traffic profile and SSO details. Any data residency constraints? Also recommend Dedicated for predictable throughput.
Aisha (Nimbus): No strict residency constraints — US cloud is fine. We do require SSO + SCIM and audit logs for compliance.
Emma (CSM): Noted. Tentative timeline: Week 0 — kickoff + access, Week 1–2 — test env + sample embedding run, Week 3 — pilot with 200k docs, Week 6 — production cutover. Open to adjusting.
Devin (Solutions Eng): For the pilot, can you share a 5k-doc sample and expected query mix? Also, do you want prefix caching on the search side?
Aisha (Nimbus): Will share sample and query mix by Friday. Prefix caching sounds good if it helps latency.
Priya (CS Ops): Risks: SSO certificate exchange delays, customer data export cleanup, and embedding quality regressions. We should add automatic regression checks against baseline prompts.
Marko (Platform Eng): Action items for infra: 1) Validate Dedicated capacity plan, 2) Reserve GPUs for pilot window (wk 3), 3) Enable KV cache in staging.
OnboardBot: Created onboarding checklist: https://redwood.onboard/checklists/1752003456 — items: SSO setup, dataset ingest, sample evals, canary traffic, SLA agreement.
Emma (CSM): Assignments: Emma -> overall CSM, Devin -> solution/embedding tuning, Marko -> infra & dedicated setup, Priya -> success criteria & rollout plan, Aisha -> provide data/sample + security contacts.
Devin (Solutions Eng): Quick technical note: please include expected average doc length and embedding dimensionality preference (512/768). It affects model choice and cost.
Aisha (Nimbus): Avg doc ~ 250 tokens, prefer 768 dims if feasible.
Priya (CS Ops): Can we schedule a deep-dive next Tue 10am PT for SSO + ingest?
Emma (CSM): Yes — sending calendar invite now and adding agenda. Agenda (snippet):
```
- Introductions (10m)
- Data & security requirements (20m)
- Ingest pipeline + sample data (20m)
- Pilot plan + success metrics (15m)
- Next steps & timelines (5m)
```
Devin (Solutions Eng): I’ll bring a short checklist for evaluation metrics + sample prompt set.
Marko (Platform Eng): I’ll bring estimated capacity numbers for Dedicated and cost delta vs hosted.
Aisha (Nimbus): Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Looking forward.
Emma (CSM): Perfect — I’ll update the onboarding checklist with these assignments and post follow-ups after the deep-dive. :thumbsup:
